title: Autonomous Trading Invariant & Risk Diode Specification
author: Antigravity CTO
description: Formal Spec-Driven Development (SDD) contract enforcing Buffett Rule #1, risk caps, and deterministic order execution.

invariants.name: Buffett Rule #1 Capital Preservation
invariants.description: Never lose principal. Maximum portfolio risk allocation is strictly capped at 1.0% NAV.

invariants.name: Defined-Risk Spread Structure
invariants.description: All option trades must have a protective long leg. Unhedged naked option writes are strictly prohibited.

invariants.name: Selective Regime & Delta Filtering
invariants.description: Entries are only permitted when IV Rank >= 30, short delta <= 0.15, and underlying is above the 200-day moving average.

invariants.name: Fast Capital Recycling (50% Profit Harvesting)
invariants.description: Spreads must be harvested at 50% max credit to eliminate late-stage gamma tail risk and maximize annualized IRR.

invariants.name: Deterministic Single-Order Identity
invariants.description: Every submitted order must carry a unique, deterministic order idempotency token to prevent double-fills.
